definitions.gloss: proceeding simultaneously; running in parallel; concurrent progress
definitions.explanation: Multiple tasks, events, or processes advancing at the same time. Used in work, project management, and everyday situations involving multitasking.

examples.japanese: {二|ふた}つのプロジェクトを{同時進行|どうじしんこう}している。
{準備|じゅんび}と{練習|れんしゅう}を{同時進行|どうじしんこう}で{進|すす}めよう。
examples.english: Let's move forward with preparations and practice at the same time.

examples.japanese: この{映画|えいが}は{三|みっ}つのストーリーが{同時進行|どうじしんこう}で{描|えが}かれている。
examples.english: This movie depicts three stories unfolding simultaneously.

notes:
USAGE:
Often used with the particle で to indicate manner: {同時進行|どうじしんこう}で{進|すす}める (to advance things in parallel). Common in business and creative contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {同時進行|どうじしんこう}で{進|すす}める (to advance in parallel)
- {同時進行|どうじしんこう}する (to proceed simultaneously)
- {複数|ふくすう}の{作業|さぎょう}を{同時進行|どうじしんこう}する (to run multiple tasks concurrently)
